name: Atlas Operator Assistant
purpose: Read-only operator reasoning over live status, comparison runs, events, and runtime safety flags.

collaboration_contract: NLU classifies intent and extracts entities for typed and voice inputs
Ask Atlas and voice share one understanding path before routing
Scanner and trader produce candidates; neither bypasses execution authority
ExecutionGate is sole authority for trade execution decisions
UI reflects state, blockers, and mode labels from shared runtime status
Dashboard and typed/voice Ask Atlas share a read-only research-progress view
Frozen learning experiments inform review; qualification never automatically changes strategy, risk or execution policy
failure_recovery: If voice fails, typed Ask Atlas remains operational
If UI fails, status/events remain source of truth for recovery
If scanner fails, trader core loop and safety gates continue
If broker unavailable, execution remains blocked and reported
safe_escalation_rules: Require confirmation for destructive system commands
Refuse or safety-route any request to bypass guards
Prefer NO_TRADE when confluence is weak or contradictory

reasoning_coordination.informational_evidence: Status, runtime flags, recent events, learning state and confirmation proof are captured once per informational request and referenced by a decision key and content fingerprints.
reasoning_coordination.event_window: Most recent 160 events, including risk and learning events, for the dashboard and main answer paths.
reasoning_coordination.atomicity_limit: The capture pins each source read for one answer; separate files are not an atomic broker snapshot.

conversation_memory.scope: One local operator conversation shared by dashboard and standalone voice workers
conversation_memory.authority: Follow-up continuity only. Cannot change strategy, risk, execution policy or command authority.
conversation_memory.redaction: Known API-key patterns and credential assignments are redacted before persistence.

reasoning_coordination.broker_outcome_claims: Confirmed closures come from the matching account-scoped closed-position ledger with decision links and non-test evidence. Learning examples alone are not broker confirmation; comparison views do not borrow live-account closure proof.
reasoning_coordination.adaptation_metrics: Heuristic proxy estimates; not measured retraining speed or proof of trading improvement.
reasoning_coordination.permissions: Enabled automation does not override a blocked or waiting current candidate. The shared reasoning projection cannot grant broker authority.
reasoning_coordination.explicit_commands: Retain their separate live command path; informational evidence pinning does not broaden command actions.
